purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged; consumers aggregating revenue filter or net them deliberately.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are excluded as capture artifacts; clock-drift re-scans collapse to the earliest timestamp; customer_id stays null on guest checkouts.
